title: INFO is a digital agency, not a platform builder, and its posture is unverified
content:
INFO is recorded as a digital agency that delivered work for Dimpact, which places it adjacent to the Dutch municipal cohort without establishing that it builds platforms. The distinction the assessment draws is between agency and platform builder, and it puts INFO on the agency side.

That matters because the two engage differently: an agency's leverage sits in the delivery projects it wins, a platform builder's in what it maintains and reuses across clients. The record explicitly says to verify open-source posture before investing effort, so the Dimpact connection is a reason to look rather than a reason to prioritise. Priority 3.
